subject: Quick technical check before product demo — BrightPath Health
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick tech screen before demo?

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the invite to the full demo next week. We're evaluating latency and integration constraints for an internal POC and my lead engineer wants to do a short technical triage first (15 minutes) to confirm tokenization, KV cache behavior, and any restrictions around private model hosting.

Could we do a quick 15-minute technical screen this week? Our engineer, Priya (cc'd on this thread), is available Tue/Wed afternoons PT. If you prefer to send a short note with answers to the questions below that's fine too.

High-level questions: 
- Can you confirm support for private VPC deployment and KMS integration?
- Typical warm-start latency at 1024 tokens on T4/GPU variants?
- How large are upload limits for model artifacts and config?

Appreciate it — want to make sure the full demo focuses on the right areas.

Best,
Alex
Platform Lead, BrightPath Health

Attachment: BrightPath-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet of questions)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick tech screen before demo?

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the context and the questionnaire. Happy to run a focused 15-minute technical triage this week. I have a short window Tues 3/24 between 2:30–3:30pm PT and Wed 3/25 11:00–12:00pm PT. I've also included a direct scheduling link if you'd like to pick a slot: https://cal.redwood.com/jasmine-15m

I'll include a Redwood engineer on the call to answer the kernel/latency questions — tagging Dev Patel (internal). If you can confirm which slot works or share Priya's preferred time, I'll send a calendar invite.

Quick answers in case you want an immediate surface-level response:
- Private VPC + KMS: supported (we can share an architecture diagram on the triage).
- Warm-start latency: depends on model variant; for our quantized LLaMA-derived 7B profile on T4 we typically see 8–15ms/token at 1024 tokens when warmed; we'll bring numbers for the model families you care about.
- Artifact limits: S3-compatible uploads — recommend keeping artifacts under 10GB for on-prem transfer; hosted pulls support chunked upload.

Attaching a short demo prep doc that outlines what we'll cover in 15m so we don't waste time.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-demo-guide.pdf
